summary: New installations are complete from day one, and Invardia support can now install PIM Manager for you.

new.title: Invardia support can install for you
new.text: Invardia support can now run the installation with its Support app, for your tenant only. At least one named person becomes the PIM Manager administrator.

fixes.title: New Pro installations update themselves
fixes.text: A new Pro or trial installation now gets its nightly update from Invardia from day one, on ring 3 by default.

fixes.title: Install key in place within minutes
fixes.text: The installation stores the install key Invardia issued, or claims it within five minutes instead of up to six hours.

fixes.title: Managing and managed tenant setup completes
fixes.text: This setup now also registers the licence, gives Invardia support its access and sets up Pro updates.

fixes.title: New managed tenants no longer report failures
fixes.text: A new managed tenant says "nothing to apply" while nothing is published for it yet, instead of failing.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The health check runs on brand-new installations, hand-run updates respect Invardia's rings, and Invardia's contact details and edition wording are corrected.
